js: JSON.stringify({ dpr: window.devicePixelRatio, iw: innerWidth, ih: innerHeight })

label: article-styles
js: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('[data-testid="start-article"]'); const p = a.querySelector('p'); const h = a.querySelector('.start-article-heading'); const cs = getComputedStyle(a), ps = getComputedStyle(p); return JSON.stringify({ articleClass: a.className, marginBottom: cs.marginBottom, paddingLeft: cs.paddingLeft, borderLeft: cs.borderLeft, pColor: ps.color, pFont: ps.fontSize, headingDisplay: getComputedStyle(h).display, headingJustify: getComputedStyle(h).justifyContent }) })()

label: bar-css-rule
js: (() => { const out=[]; for (const ss of document.styleSheets) { try { for (const r of ss.cssRules) { if (r.selectorText && r.selectorText.includes('start-article')) out.push(r.cssText.slice(0,160)) } } catch(e){} } return JSON.stringify(out) })()
